t: The Hager J201 20A 4-terminal junction box provides a reliable solution for electrical wiring connections. Manufactured from durable plastic, it ensures secure and insulated housing for circuits. Featuring solid machined brass terminals, it ensures robust and efficient electrical contact. A single centre screw securely fastens the cover, allowing for straightforward installation and maintenance. The terminals accept up to 4 x 2.5mm² cables, offering versatile connectivity for various electrical projects.
b: Cover Secured By Single Centre Screws
